name: Alert Sage RAG baseline
description: A bilingual, document-level retrieval benchmark for representative operations incidents.

documents.title: Checkout high CPU after database query regression
documents.symptom: Checkout API CPU remained above 90 percent and request latency increased after a release.
documents.root_cause: A changed SQL query caused sequential scans and saturated the database-bound request path.
documents.resolution: Compare EXPLAIN ANALYZE plans, restore the previous index-friendly query and verify CPU and latency recovery.

documents.title: Payment worker memory leak and OOM restart
documents.symptom: Payment workers showed steadily growing heap usage and were repeatedly terminated by the OOM killer.
documents.root_cause: A release retained completed payment payloads in an unbounded in-process cache.
documents.resolution: Disable the cache path, deploy the bounded cache fix and compare heap profiles before and after the release.

documents.title: Inventory Redis connection pool exhaustion
documents.symptom: Inventory requests timed out while Redis connection wait time and active connections reached their limits.
documents.root_cause: A missing client cleanup path leaked Redis connections until the application pool was exhausted.
documents.resolution: Close clients on every request path, raise pool observability and restart affected instances after deploying the fix.

documents.title: Order API latency caused by downstream timeout amplification
documents.symptom: Order API p99 latency rose sharply and request queues grew while a downstream pricing service was degraded.
documents.root_cause: Long downstream timeouts and synchronized retries amplified pricing-service latency across order workers.
documents.resolution: Reduce the downstream timeout, add jittered retry limits and enable the pricing circuit breaker.

documents.title: Authentication failures after TLS certificate expiry
documents.symptom: Authentication requests failed with TLS handshake errors immediately after the service certificate expired.
documents.root_cause: The certificate renewal job used an obsolete secret path and did not update the active gateway certificate.
documents.resolution: Renew and rotate the certificate, correct the secret path and alert before the next expiry window.

documents.title: Notification delay caused by worker queue backlog
documents.symptom: Email and push notifications arrived more than twenty minutes late while the pending queue grew continuously.
documents.root_cause: A slow template rendering call reduced worker throughput below the incoming notification rate.
documents.resolution: Cache compiled templates, add workers temporarily and alert on queue age as well as queue depth.
